title: Image to Text – Copy Text from a Photo or Screenshot, Free
description: Copy the text out of a photo, scan or screenshot in your browser: English and Arabic, one picture or many. Free, nothing is uploaded.
heading: Image to text
subtitle: Get the text out of a photo, scan or screenshot, in English or Arabic; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Turn an image into text without sending it anywhere: text recognition (OCR) runs in your browser and reads the words in a photo of a page, a scan, a receipt or a screenshot. Copy the text, or download it as a .txt or Markdown file. Choose several pictures and they are read one after another into one text, with each file's name as a heading. The first time, the text reader (about 10 MB) is loaded from this site and kept by your browser, so later it works offline.

features.title: Private
features.text: The picture is read on your device; it never goes to a server.

features.title: English and Arabic
features.text: English, Arabic, or both in the same picture.

features.title: Many pictures at once
features.text: Read a whole set of photos or screenshots into one text.

stepsTitle: How to copy text from an image

steps.title: Choose your pictures
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop one or more images on the page.

steps.title: Pick the language
steps.text: Choose the language of the text in the pictures.

steps.title: Read the text
steps.text: Click Read text; the progress is shown picture by picture.

steps.title: Copy or download
steps.text: Copy the text, or download it as .txt or .md.

handles: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF, SVG and iPhone HEIC pictures.
Photos of printed pages, scans, receipts and screenshots.
English and Arabic, alone or together.
Several pictures in one go, with a heading per file.
limits: Text recognition makes mistakes, more so on blurry, small, curved or handwritten text; check what matters.
Each language's text reader loads from this site the first time you use it (about 10 MB for both); after that it works offline.
Tables and columns come out as lines of words, not as a table.

faq.question: Is my image uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your picture is read by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I copy text from a screenshot?
faq.answer: Choose the screenshot here, pick the language and click Read text. The text appears in a box with a Copy button, and you can download it as a text or Markdown file.

faq.question: Can it read Arabic?
faq.answer: Yes. Printed Arabic reads well, alone or mixed with English on the same picture.

faq.question: Does it read handwriting?
faq.answer: Not reliably. It is made for printed text; handwriting usually comes out wrong.

faq.question: I have a scanned PDF, not a picture. What do I use?
faq.answer: Use OCR PDF: it reads every page and lays the text over it, so the PDF itself becomes searchable.

faq.question: What does the first use download?
faq.answer: The text reader and the language data, about 10 MB, from this site itself. Your browser keeps them, so later uses start at once and work offline.
